final: SELECT zoneref, articount, CAST(articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(articount) OVER (), 0) AS share, CAST(articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(articount) OVER (), 0) - AVG(CAST(articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(articount) OVER (), 0)) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
